headline: Already have a benefits scheme?
body: get perks sits alongside it. Your people keep the perks they already enjoy and gain free help with the big money decisions: mortgages, protection, wills and wealth.
note: Co-branded portal and launch pack included.

linkedin:
Already have a benefits scheme? Good. Get Perks is designed to sit alongside it.

Your people keep the perks they already know. What they gain is free help with the big money decisions: buying or remortgaging a home, protecting their family, writing a will and planning their savings.

That help comes from brokers who do the work themselves, so your HR team does not have to become money experts.

You get a co-branded portal, a launch pack and anonymised reporting on how your people use it.

getperks.co.uk

Your home may be repossessed if you do not keep up repayments on your mortgage.

#EmployeeBenefits #Reward #HR #FinancialWellbeing
